mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% triggers recession fears and policy tightening expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in housing starts and retail sales indicates robust consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint positive movement of HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%) signals economic weakness, prompting accommodative monetary policy that supports equity valuations and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output, correlating with stronger corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO rises.

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly GDP growth below 0.5% annualized signals economic contraction, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 < 0.5% annualized.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent high interest rates (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%) and high inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%) indicate restrictive monetary policy, depressing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0% fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Strong housing market activity (HOUST > 1100 thousand units) boosts consumer confidence and spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1100.
